content.title: Media startup Semafor raises $30M in new financing, WSJ reports
content.summary: The media startup Semafor has raised $30M in new financing that values the company at $330M after its first profitable year, The Wall Street Journal’s Isabella Simonetti reports. The roughly three-year-old startup, which counts KKR (KKR) co-founder Henry Kravis, David Rubenstein of Carlyle Group (CG) and Penny Pritzker’s PSP Partners among its backers, aims to hire more journalists and expand its live-events business.
